title: Flydubai Grounds Israel Flights, United Puts a Velvet Rope on First Class, and TSA Takes Away the Chairs
summary: An update on yesterday's flydubai cockpit attack as the airline suspends all Tel Aviv flights mid-investigation. Plus, United rolls out "basic" first class because apparently no cabin is safe from fare tiers anymore, Lufthansa says goodbye to its last A340-600, and TSA decides standing up is the secret to "hospitality." We'll also run through a handful of new routes popping up this week.
